B7#I6Y64=v7mca!pl}r!.text:
Overseer Rischva
PL: 300000
MPL: 14
Unique Abilities: 
Magic Control - Can control others' magic orbs, up to his own MPL of 14. This allows him to stop orbs in midair, change their trajectory, move them around, or even cause them to vanish entirely.
Can also create his magic orbs out of thin air.
Cannot control any magic types besides basic orbs.
Total Counter x2 - Counters the effects of any attack, completely nullifying any effects said attack has. Cannot be used after the attack has already hit, except to remove the status effects inflicted by status-ailment attacks.
Resuscitate (1 use per day. Revives target with 10% HP, but only if target died less than a minute before.)
Solar Magic (Gains +1 ATK while in direct sunlight.)
Techniques:
Beam Magic (Fires a powerful, fast-moving beam with a 1.5x damage multiplier.)
Fight Magic (Channels magic into fists or feet to punch enemies. 2.5x damage multiplier.)
Solar Flash
Spamming Magic - Spams many shots at once.
Reliable Magic - A unique magic type that always deals 5 damage, no matter the foe's DEF. Useful in some cases, useless in others.
1x Photosynthetic Blast
Charged Fight Magic (Fight Magic that takes longer to charge, but comes with +1 ATK.)
5x Overcharge Fight Magic (Fight Magic with +2 ATK)
